title: Single-cell multi-omic profiling allows the dissection of peripheral immune phenotypes in Alzheimer’s Disease progression

evidence_spans.quote: Here, we employed three high-resolution single-cell techniques
to investigate peripheral immunity in AD dementia
in contrast to healthy aging across cohorts

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An empirical human immune study explicitly contrasts AD progression phenotypes with healthy aging and reports multi-omic profiling.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: AD dementia and earlier stages of the AD trajectory
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: peripheral immune phenotypes, including B-cell compartment and classical monocyte expansion
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Immune phenotypes across AD progression in contrast to healthy aging
